## apiome teams {#teams}

Teams: who owns catalog entities and is notified about their findings.

```text
apiome teams [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`assign`](#teams-assign), [`create`](#teams-create), [`list`](#teams-list), [`members`](#teams-members), [`show`](#teams-show).

## apiome teams assign {#teams-assign}

Make a team the confirmed owner of an entity (PUT …/owners/{kind}/{id}).

The previous confirmed owner, if any, is replaced; findings for the entity are routed to the new team. An unknown team or entity is refused with REST's message and exits 2; an unknown kind is a usage error (exit 2) caught before any call.

```text
apiome teams assign [OPTIONS] KIND ENTITY_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KIND` | text | yes | Entity kind: project, catalog_item, mcp_endpoint, consumer, connector. |
| `ENTITY_ID` | text | yes | The entity's id. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--team` | text |  | yes | Slug of the team that will own it. |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome teams create {#teams-create}

Create a team (POST …/teams). The slug cannot be changed afterwards.

A taken slug or a malformed field is refused by REST and exits 2.

```text
apiome teams create [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NAME` | text | yes | The team's display name. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--slug` | text |  |  | Permanent slug (default: derived from the name). Gateway tags owner:&lt;slug&gt; use it. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | What the team does. |
| `--contact-email` | text |  |  | The team's contact address. |
| `--chat-url` | text |  |  | Chat channel link (absolute http(s) URL). |
| `--oncall-url` | text |  |  | On-call / paging link (absolute http(s) URL). |
| `--docs-url` | text |  |  | Team docs or runbook link (absolute http(s) URL). |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome teams members {#teams-members}

List a team's members, or replace them (PUT …/teams/{slug}/members).

With no option the members are listed. ``--set`` sends the **complete** new membership — it does not add to the current one — and ``--clear`` empties the team. Every user must belong to the workspace, otherwise REST refuses the whole change (exit 2) and nothing changes.

```text
apiome teams members [OPTIONS] SLUG
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SLUG` | text | yes | Team slug. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--set` | text (repeatable) |  |  | USER_ID[:lead\|:member] (repeatable; default role member). Replaces the whole membership: anyone not listed is removed. |
| `--clear` | flag |  |  | Remove every member (cannot be combined with --set). |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |
